relationships.evidence_quote: When P2X4 receptors were blocked by the 5-BDBD before carrageenan challenging, the p-p38 MAPK expression was decreased (Fig 4B and 4C, p < 0.0001).

relationships.subject: P2X4
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that carrageenan induces an increase in macrophage activation towards an inflammatory phenotype through pathways involving P2X4 receptors.

relationships.subject: P2X4
relationships.evidence_quote: These results demonstrated that, in skeletal muscle tissue, P2X4 receptors are involved in the transition of acute to persistent inflammatory muscle hyperalgesia.

relationships.subject: Physical exercise
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that physical exercise modulated p38 MAPK phosphorylation during the inflammatory process through PPARγ receptors activation in muscle tissue.

key_findings: P2X4 blockade with 5-BDBD partially reversed acute and persistent muscle hyperalgesia and reduced p-p38 MAPK and M1-like macrophage activation.
Exercise prevented p38 MAPK phosphorylation via PPARγ (reversed by GW9662).
